title: Moreish Puff Summer Cider On Ice Pear 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pear Moreish Puff Summer Cider on Ice captures the crisp, cool refreshment of a deliciously dry apple cider on a summer’s day, with the addition of fresh, sweet and luscious pear for even more irresistible flavour, finished with a burst of icy menthol for ultimate refreshment. Summer Cider on Ice is a fantastic new range of e-liquids from Moreish Puff inspired by the merriment and refreshment associated with that beloved summer beverage, cider. Each Moreish Puff Summer Cider on Ice e-liquid features a distinctly delicious fruit flavour paired with a crisp, dry apple cider and shot through with an extra refreshing layer of menthol. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle helps ensure your favourite e-liquid really goes the distance and comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your juice’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks . Shortfills are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their high-VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-liquid helps ensure you don’t run out too quickly.
